core_obligations: Simultaneous induction framing (proof lines 858-861): assume all three numbered properties (Valphatrans, Valphapotent, Valphacum) below alpha.
Empty case (line 863): trivial, recorded as such.
Successor case (lines 864-873): cumulation from the hypothesis via powerset membership; potency by subset-closure under V_beta; transitivity by two unfoldings through the hypothesis.
Limit case (lines 874-881): cumulation by inserting gamma in its own successor stage inside the union; transitivity and potency as union-of-families observations stated in one sentence.
proof_roadmap: Set up simultaneous induction on alpha.
Unfold the powerset equations for the successor stage, one property at a time.
At limits, use the successor-insertion trick and closure of unions.
